notes.title: Update 1.06.02
notes.content:
Here we are! A gigantic update to FLSM with a bunch of new things, improvements to existing things, and fixes for things that weren't supposed to be how they were.

There's a new environment, finally, a [b]Cyber Loft[/b], smack in the middle of a far off city. Take in the sounds and smells and feel of a gritty cyberpunk apartment while smashing the night away in bliss.

New shapes, textures, and more have been added into the Character Creator, so now you can have even more fun making truly unique and sexy characters to play with.

I've improved the penetration system and all sex poses so they're even more animated and alive.

Anyway, yeah, there's a lot in there, so I hope you all enjoy it. :)

Thanks for your patience and support!
~ ripened peach

[h2]Changes in the update, in no super particular order:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added the Cyber Loft environment, to help out with super cyber, cyber sex situations.
[*]Improved overall graphics and lighting systems so things look even better.
[*]Added new Photo Taking section to the Editor, so now you can take a photo of your character when you save them, instead of the wonky automatic-image it used to make.
[*]Added new standing poses to the Editor so your characters can look all cool and all.
[*]Added new nipple textures to the Editor, for more nipplish nipples.
[*]Added new nipple morphs to the Editor, for more stickeroutish nipple variety.
[*]Added new lips textures to the Editor, because lips.
[*]Added new skin textures to the Editor, offering a wider variety of skin tones and textures for character customization.
[*]Added new monster head morphs to the Editor, because hot monsters are hot.
[*]Added new alien feet morphs to the Editor for enhanced customization of non-human (or hey, human - don't judge) characters.
[*]Added an extra "pattern" layer to the Editor, for more complex texture customization and layering.
[*]Added a character rotation slider to the Editor, so you can spin to win your character during customization.
[*]Added "Hold SHIFT" functionality for faster adjustments of various increment/decrement (+/-) buttons in the Editor.
[*]Added special notices to the Editor for better handling of various character configuration warnings and errors.
[*]Fixed penis coloring options and alpha channel handling in the Editor to allow for more accurate skin tone adjustments and transparency.
[*]Fixed an issue where vaginal pubic hair was being incorrectly displayed when the penis option was selected in the Editor.
[*]Improved character skin textures, increasing detail and visual fidelity.
[*]Improved genital textures and alpha channels to better match up with character skin tones.
[*]Improved skin specularity settings to better reflect light and enhance overall skin rendering.
[*]Improved eye color reflections and shaders for more lifelike eyes.
[*]Rewrote the "head look" system, improving character gaze behaviors for more realistic look directions.
[*]Added custom offset calculations to accommodate larger character models more effectively.
[*]Added additional leg animations, subtly enhancing motion during orgasms.
[*]Added minor leg and foot movement and bounce during some poses because leg and feet bounce is sexy.
[*]Adjusted body and limb positioning logic in poses for more anatomically correct postures.
[*]Fine-tuned hand and finger placement during poses so there's less pop-through (see final note at end).
[*]Added a new breast dynamics system, enabling more realistic breast movement and bounce.
[*]Added breast jiggle effects when clothing comes off, because that's fun.
[*]Improved breast shape handling in specific poses to ensure more accurate and visually appealing results.
[*]Fixed issues with unnatural breast shapes in animations where certain interactions were causing distortions.
[*]Added a penetration aiming system to improve precision and control over character positioning and interactions.
[*]Added pelvic rotation and aiming adjustments to enhance penetration accuracy during animations.
[*]Added additional genital animations for more expressive and detailed movements during sex and orgasms.
[*]Added thigh quiver and shake effects to orgasms, making for sexier, lifelike movements.
[*]Improved cum collider accuracy to enhance cum splatter and dripping on characters.
[*]Improved scrotum dynamics and collision handling for more realistic testicle physics during sex. Boing boing boing.
[*]Added micro eye saccades to simulate small, involuntary eye movements for added realism.
[*]Improved character head movement system, resulting in smoother and more natural head motions.
[*]Improved facial expression blending to better reflect a wider range of character emotions.
[*]Improved lip-syncing precision for more accurate mouth movements during speech.
[*]Added occasional character glances during idle sequences when clothing is removed. Ooh la la...
[*]Improved the idle scene camera to an orbital configuration, allowing for full 360-degree character viewing.
[*]Fixed an issue where incorrect animation timing affected certain idle poses.
[*]Added Environment Choice area to Character Selection screen UI.
[*]Rewrote the "Be Me" (POV) system for improved performance and a more seamless first-person experience.
[*]Added an in-game reminder for mouse usage to assist in looking around while in POV mode.
[*]Added a "Look at Me" option to character interaction menus for sexy sultry smokin' looks.
[*]Added new audio feedback to certain UI interactions for enhanced user experience.
[*]Added ability for poses to dynamically recognize compatible character setups, with the UI adjusting accordingly.
[*]Added tooltips to more things and improved how fast tooltips show up.
[*]Improved the design and layout of the Action Bar and pose button UI elements.
[*]Improved the "Partner's Choice" pose selection system to make things even that much sexier.
[*]Fixed an issue where Action Bar drag-and-drop selections were not persisting between sessions.
[*]Fixed inconsistencies in zoom functionality, improving zoom speed and key responsiveness.
[*]Added animated loading bars to several loading screens to better indicate background processes.
[*]Added sliders to the settings menu for adjusting mouse sensitivity and scroll speed.
[*]Improved camera fade transitions to ensure smoother scene changes.
[*]Fixed a bug where Load buttons occasionally failed to appear on the Character Selection screen.
[*]Fixed the minimum screen resolution to ensure better UI scaling on some displays.
[*]Added a Master Volume slider to the settings menu for global audio control.
[*]Added a "New" button to the Character Editor, allowing users to quickly start a new character without having to leave the Editor first.
[*]Added a loading animation to the Editor when resetting or starting a new character to provide visual feedback and prevent the appearance of freezing.
[*]Improved ambient lighting on hair models to ensure better visibility in shadowed areas, reducing excessive darkness.
[*]Fixed an issue with color pickers displaying incorrect colors in certain screen resolutions or aspect ratios.
[*]Fixed a problem where loading content into the Character Editor while the Cyber Loft environment was active caused incorrect camera views.
[*]Fixed an issue where solo poses weren't setting POV buttons correctly in some instances.
[*]Fixed a bug where Partner Choice selections could occasionally be duplicated.
[*]Fixed an issue where custom penis/scrotum sizes failed to load properly when loading a character.
[*]Fixed a problem where the Settings UI would appear at incorrect sizes on some resolutions, ensuring better scaling across devices.
[*]Added breast stiffness buttons to Editor so you can control the bouncy bounce.
[*]Added Bounce button to Editor so you can see how the breasts, etc. look while in a bouncy sex pose.
[*]Added additional head movement during blowjob animations for more realism.
[*]Added testicle throb during orgasms so they throb like throbbing testicles should throb.
[*]Improved penetration aiming, so mostly all body shape penises line up correctly.
[*]Fixed broken breast bounce where sometimes they would just... yeah... way too much. Anyway, fixed!
[*]Fixed Photo Preview in Editor to fit better on non-standard resolutions.
[*]Fixed incorrect UI sizing on non-standard resolutions.
[*]Refactored significant portions of the code base, resulting in overall performance improvements and higher code quality.
[*]Addressed and resolved pages of bugs. Pages. And pages.
[/list]
There are a bunch of things I forgot to add to this change log, because I write everything down in a notepad as I'm going, and my writing is very often atrocious. When I go back over some of the crossed out things months later to see what I did, I'm usually like WTF does that say??

notes.title: FLSM 1.06.02 beta
notes.content:
[b]This build is now live, but I'm leaving this here for posterity.[/b]

------------------------------------------------

[b]FLSM 1.06.02[/b] is ready to try in the beta area.

If you want to try it out...
[list]
[*]Open your Steam client and go to the [i]Future Love Space Machine page[/i] (where the "Play" button is).
[*]Over to the right is a little gear icon. Click that and choose "Properties".
[*]Go to the "Betas" section and use the drop down menu to select "[i]beta_public - for testing updates[/i]".
[*]Close that window and Steam should then start downloading the update. You might have to hit the "Play" button first.
[*]It should now say "SELECTED VERSION beta_public" next to the "Play" button.
[*]If you want to go back to the current public version again, do the gear thing again and choose "None" instead of "beta_public".
[*]That's it! Enjoy. :)
[/list]
The beta version will be there for a week or so before I make it the regular public build. If you find any game-breaking bugs please post in the forum. There still may be a few little visual bugs here and there and they're likely the ones on my list for the next update. If anything freezes or whatever, try to remember what you were doing right before it happened so you can say so in the forum. That would be super helpful.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.059.03
notes.content:
We're back with an update, and this one is huge!

Thanks to everyone for your suggestions and help. It really made a positive difference for us in getting this out there. ːsteamhappyː


[h3]In this update...[/h3]

You can make [b][u]older characters[/u][/b] now, with a full set of shape sliders and even an "aged" slider setup to tweak it how you want. There are a bunch more [b][u]penis shapes[/u][/b] (we're currently also working on vulva shapes for an upcoming release), a "[b][u]pregnant[/u][/b]" shape slider, whiskers, two new [b][u]eye styles[/u][/b] that let you choose your own color combos, new [b][u]multi layer eyeshadow and lipstick[/u][/b] options, so you can layer different colors, [b][u]freckles[/u][/b] option (face or full body), "[b][u]dirty[/u][/b]" style, etc. Oh yeah you can give your characters [b][u]nail polish[/u][/b] now. Chipped or clean.

There's also a new "[b][u]bone scaling[/u][/b]" section so you can set the character's [b][u]height and head size[/u][/b]. We'll add more bone scaling options in the future if people want it.

[b][u]Graphics have been updated[/u][/b] to 4k by default, so characters have way more detail, and lighting has been improved significantly.

Anyway there's a whole ton of stuff and it's hard to remember it all.

[h3]Workshop?[/h3]

We'd hoped to include Steam Workshop support this time around, and that's [i]almost[/i] ready (so close!), but there are [i]so[/i] many changes to the Character system in this update that we want to make sure it all works well before filling up the Workshop with characters. So Workshop support will be coming up super soon.

[h3]C U M?[/h3]

We're still working on the new c u m update. The graphics (c u m everywhere!) to it are finished and we're just busy adding in all of the "pulled out" versions of the animations so you can c u m that way too. So that's coming (hah) in an update very soon. We might combine the Workshop and c u m  system updates into one, which is likely.

Anyway, there's a long list of changes and improvements, including a slew of bug fixes. So check the list below if interested.

notes.title: Things on the horizon...
notes.content:
Just wanted to drop in and let everyone know what's going on behind the scenes here. First, though,  hello to you all, and thanks so much for supporting our project! We hope you're staying safe and sound during this super weird time. :)

So yeah, we have an update coming soon, and we've been busy adding some cool stuff to it.
[list]
[*] For the past several days I've been programming in the "c u m" system so now there will be visible squirts, splats, cream pies, etc., plus an option to "clean up" your characters after they get all messy.

[*] We're adding Workshop support for characters, so you can share them via the Steam Workshop. That's almost done.

[*] Speaking of characters, we're adding in several new additions to the Character Editor, with new makeup options, body skins, genital shapes, etc. We're also making it so character heights work, and really trying hard to make the animations work properly regardless of the character's height (within reason).

[*] We've added in a special eye mode where you can colorize the pupil, iris, and sclera of each eye independently (thanks to users for the idea!)

[*] We're trying to find a good way to let users place colored "decals" on a character, which would really open things up for even more variety. Hopefully we can come up with something that works nicely.

[*] FLSM has some glitchy screen effects to make it look like an old computer, but it turned out some people didn't understand it was intentional and thought it was visual bugs, and some people might just not like it for whatever reason. So we've added an option to toggle that on and off.

[*] There's some bug fixes coming that should also help. Always a plus.
[/list]

Anyway that's about all I can think of at the moment. Working our butts off over here and as soon as the update it ready we'll get it into your hands.

Thanks again so much!
~ Giselle and ViV
